page.layout: Running head at top, page number 424 at top left. Full-width running text in paragraphs. Below it a heading in italics. Then two parallel tables (left: 29 Aug.–15 Sept. / Thoth 1–18; right: 16 Sept.–3 Oct. / 19–6) with column headers above. A marginal label "Paophi." beside the right table's first Coptic row. A sign "4—D" at the lower right, below the tables.

main_text.p: hoc est, XI kal. Aprilis: satis intelligitur eum loqui de Phamenoth Diocletiani. Sic quādo Nicephorus Archiepiscopus Constantinopolitanus in Chronologia suarefert [?] Christum natum esse anno 42 imperij Augusti, die 29 Chiac, hoc est, 25 Decembris; intelligit Chiac Diocletiani, non autem Nabonasari: & quan-do Epiphanius scribit Christum natum esse anno 42 ab imperio Augusti, die vndecima Tybi secundum Ægyptios, qui fuit secundum Romanos ante diem octauum Iduum Ianuarij, manifestum est eum loqui de Tybi Diocletiani.
Vt autem rectè percipiatur, quibus diebus calendarij Iuliani respondeat dies Coptitarum, totum annum hac ratione conferre oportet: quod etiam fecit Episcopus Forofempronienis.
main_text.l: Menses Iul. | Menses Coptitarum. | Menses Iul. | Menses Coptitarum.

page.notes: Dashes between the month letters and the day columns are printed rules and are not transcribed. The first word of the first paragraph, "suarefert", is uncertain: the scan reads "fuarcfert". The XI in "XI kal." has an overline in print, which is not copied. The right table's last row shows "4—D" below the table; it is treated as the catchword. The right-hand column header is printed slightly blurred ("Menscs"). The "Paophi." label is printed to the right of the table, so it is a note.
